name: Kotori Mako
source:
The conscience of the arts club.

She freezes upon hearing scary stories, but she doesn't dislike ghost stories or horror.

She's very friendly, and one of the few people who are loved by all of her classmates.

She's normally kind to everyone, but she likes pulling people's legs every once in a while.

She's moved all across the country when she was little due to her parents' jobs, but she's originally from west Kodamamachi.

"I got startled but this might be awesome!"
